premises.text: Growing high-quality cannabis requires extensive knowledge and is difficult for users
premises.evidence_span: the barriers to entry are just too high

premises.text: Leaf automates the cannabis growing process and is controlled via smartphone
premises.evidence_span: Leaf is a plug-in-plant system that automatically grows cannabis and is controlled by your smartphone

premises.text: Leaf uses custom-built LED lighting tailored for cannabis growth
premises.evidence_span: created by lead NASA agricultural lighting researchers and tailored specifically for cannabis growth

premises.text: Leaf manages environmental factors like nutrient dosing, pH, temperature, and humidity
premises.evidence_span: Leaf takes care of automatic nutrient dosing, pH balancing, temperature control, humidity control, odor neutralization

premises.text: Leaf provides a community feature for users to share and sync growing recipes
premises.evidence_span: we can see what other growers in the community are growing

premises.text: Leaf delivers all necessary supplies directly to users' doors
premises.evidence_span: we make it extremely easy by sending you directly to your door every grow, nutrients, carbon filters, anything you need to grow

value.text: Users can easily grow high-quality cannabis in a controlled environment
value.evidence_span: growing your own cannabis has never been easier
